_note: School of Sport container context pack for reflective-practice-intermediate. The School of Sport is one academic school spanning several sport subjects (sport & exercise science, sport coaching and physical education, sport management and development, sport therapy and rehabilitation, strength & conditioning). There is NO QAA benchmark for sport in this repo, so subject carries no scheme, code or benchmarkId. Worked examples draw on a DIFFERENT subject across the lessons: L01 sport & exercise science, L02 sport coaching, L03 sport therapy and rehabilitation.
